label: Local scenes
definition: Local specificity in everyday settings and uses.

label: Curated local scenes
definition: Local characteristics with curation, decoration and display orientation.

label: Glocal scenes
definition: Local references combined with standardised commercial forms.

label: Global scenes
definition: Generic commercial environments with limited local specificity.

label: Architecture
definition: Built form, facades and structural components.

label: Natural features
definition: Vegetation and other natural features appearing as environmental content.

label: Street infrastructure
definition: Paving, access and street-service infrastructure.

label: Landscape decoration
definition: Ornamental and scenographic elements.

label: Commercial signage
definition: Signs, logos and commercial identification.

label: Consumption interfaces
definition: Goods, food and service-related interfaces.

label: Display facilities
definition: Stages and facilities supporting performance or exhibition.

label: Digital production
definition: On-site shooting and digital content creation.

label: Performance
definition: Stylised posing and themed public display.

label: Consumption
definition: Daily shopping and service consumption.

label: Social interaction
definition: Conversation, interaction, co-presence and collective observation.

label: Rest
definition: Functional stopping and scenery-oriented stopping.

label: Movement
definition: Routine transit and leisure wandering.

label: Focal figures
definition: Visible figures occupying the primary visual focus of a scene.

label: Background figures
definition: Visible figures without constituting the primary visual focus.

label: Media-oriented behaviour
definition: The body functions as visual material for image production, display or circulation; assigned through the subtype crosswalk.

label: Everyday practice
definition: The body participates in movement, consumption, interaction, rest, work or use; assigned through the subtype crosswalk.
